title: Purchase order approval thresholds
text: All purchase orders must be approved before supplier work begins. Requests under €5,000 require budget-owner approval. Requests from €5,000 to €50,000 require Category Manager approval. Requests above €50,000 require VP Procurement approval and Finance review. Emergency purchases must be documented within 2 business days.

title: Supplier onboarding due diligence
text: New suppliers must complete KYC, sanctions screening, tax validation, and bank-account verification before receiving a purchase order. High-risk suppliers require enhanced due diligence and Legal approval. Supplier names must match registration documents exactly, including suffixes such as S.L., GmbH, Ltd., or Inc.

title: Information security requirements for SaaS suppliers
text: SaaS suppliers handling company data must provide ISO 27001 certification or SOC 2 Type II evidence. Contracts must include breach notification within 72 hours, data-processing terms, and annual security review rights. Suppliers processing EU personal data must sign a GDPR-compliant DPA before go-live.

title: RFP scoring guide for logistics providers
text: Logistics RFPs should score providers on price, service coverage, SLA performance, carbon reporting, claims handling, and implementation timeline. Price should not exceed 40% of the total score. For temperature-controlled transport, audit evidence and lane-level service history must be reviewed before award.

title: Master services agreement summary — Acme Logistics S.L.
text: Acme Logistics S.L. provides warehouse-to-store distribution services in Spain and Portugal. The MSA includes a 98.5% on-time delivery SLA, monthly KPI reporting, and service credits after two consecutive missed SLA periods. Contract renewal notice must be sent 90 days before 2027-05-12.

title: Data-processing addendum summary — Northstar Analytics Ltd.
text: Northstar Analytics Ltd. may process sales, inventory, and supplier-performance data for dashboard reporting. The DPA prohibits use of company data for model training without written approval. Sub-processors must be disclosed 30 days before onboarding. Data must be deleted within 45 days after contract termination.

title: Three-bid requirement exceptions
text: Competitive sourcing normally requires three qualified bids for spend above €25,000. Exceptions are allowed for sole-source suppliers, emergency continuity needs, regulated utilities, and renewals with documented benchmark evidence. Exceptions must include a business justification, approver name, and audit trail in the sourcing system.

title: Invoice mismatch handling
text: Invoices are matched against purchase order, goods receipt, and contracted pricing. A price variance over 3% or quantity variance over 5 units requires buyer review. Suppliers should not be paid until mismatch resolution is documented. Repeated invoice mismatches should trigger supplier performance review.

title: Can a supplier begin work before PO approval?
text: No. Suppliers should not begin work before purchase order approval. If business continuity requires emergency work, the requester must document the emergency reason, estimated spend, supplier name, and approving manager within 2 business days.

title: Which terms should be preserved in procurement search?
text: Procurement search should preserve supplier legal suffixes, RFP identifiers, PO numbers, currency amounts, dates, compliance acronyms, and standards such as GDPR, DPA, ISO 27001, SOC 2, SLA, KPI, KYC, MSA, and Incoterms. Removing these terms can damage exact-match retrieval and audit traceability.
